remarks: Don't miss this inviting 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offering 2,156 sq. ft. of comfortable living space with a bright and functional layout. The main level features spacious living and dining areas, highlighted by a wood-burning fireplace. The kitchen opens to a private, fenced yard with a stone patio-perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or play. The unfinished lower level provides abundant storage space and laundry area. Off-street parking in driveway. Enjoy an unbeatable location with easy access to the Merritt Parkway and I-95, plus proximity to public transportation, schools, restaurants, shopping, and places of worship. A wonderful opportunity to make this well-located and lovingly cared-for home your own.
